notice_subtype.description: e.g. 'Issue of Provisional Certificate', 'Replacement Title', 'Reconstruction of Lost Land Register', 'Registration of Instrument', 'Cancellation of Title Deed'

is_ownership_change.description: true only for genuine ownership-transfer notices (Registration of Instrument, Cancellation) — false for lost-document reissuance where the existing owner is just getting a replacement document

parcel_id.description: The L.R./title number, e.g. 'L.R. No. 24371/124' or 'Kiambaa/Kanunga/2545'

document_type.description: e.g. 'title deed', 'green card', 'white card', 'certificate of lease', 'land register'

new_owner.description: Only populated when is_ownership_change is true — the party receiving the parcel

succession_cause_number.description: If this notice cites a probate/succession cause (common in Registration of Instrument notices), the cause number, e.g. 'Succession Cause No. 1668 of 2020'

county.description: County or district the parcel sits in

registrar_name.description: Name of the signing Land Registrar/Registrar of Titles

objection_period.description: The specific period for objections, e.g., 'sixty (60) days', '30 days'
